summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC disclosed in a Form 6-K the repurchase of 935,500 ordinary shares under its $500 million buyback program announced July 1, 2025. Shares were acquired in three tranches on May 22, May 29, and June 5, 2026, at prices between $10.75 and $11.59, for an aggregate payment of $10,483,880.54. The repurchased shares are held in treasury, reducing outstanding float. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor was noted. The program remains open; total remaining authorization is not disclosed. Watch for continued buyback execution and potential EPS accretion effects.
